name: Nerura
source:
An arrogant and promiscuous woman on the express. During her lifetime, she suffered a horrible experience in the nightlife, and also caused great suffering to others too. In actuality, she also happens to also have a more typically feminine side to her.
[Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2024/11/30/karudea/]official website[/url]]
